column5: Features 1 texture is required by Coat Normal.
Emissive Scale must be finite and at least 0.
Fuzz cannot be combined with Glint.
Hair Marschner cannot be combined with Glint.
Displacement texture is required by Interlayer Parallax.
Coat Strength must be finite, at least 0 and at most 1
Glint Screen Space Scale must be finite, at least 1
Specular Level must be finite, at least 0 and at most 1
Fuzz Color G must be finite, at least 0
Two Layer cannot be combined with Subsurface.
